install.tail:
3. Install PostgreSQL 18 (a Windows service)
      winget install --id PostgreSQL.PostgreSQL.18 --exact --silent --override "... --servicename postgresql-x64-18 --serverport 5432 --superpassword ****"
   4. Start it at boot
      sc config postgresql-x64-18 start= auto
   5. Restart it when it fails
      sc failure postgresql-x64-18 reset= 86400 actions= restart/5000/restart/30000/restart/60000
   6. Wait for it to answer
      wait
   7. Set the superuser's password, this machine only, Kazma's database
      C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL\18\bin\psql.exe -h 127.0.0.1 -U postgres -w -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -X -q -p 5432 -d postgres < (password, settings)
   8. Restart it to apply the settings
      restart
   9. Wait for it to answer
      wait
  10. Create the kazma_app role (not a superuser)
      C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL\18\bin\psql.exe -h 127.0.0.1 -U postgres -w -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -X -q -p 5432 -d kazma < kazma_app_role.sql
  11. Give kazma_app its password
      C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL\18\bin\psql.exe -h 127.0.0.1 -U postgres -w -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -X -q -p 5432 -d kazma < (password)

The data folder: E:\Kazma
The move:

   2. PostgreSQL 18's data, WAL archive and base backups (0.1 GB):
        data: C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL\18\data -> E:\Kazma\postgres-18\data
        WAL archive: C:\ProgramData\Kazma\pg_wal_archive-18 -> E:\Kazma\postgres-18\wal_archive
        base backups: C:\kazma-drill\kazma-data\backups\pg\base-18 -> E:\Kazma\postgres-18\base
        stopped, copied and compared file by file, switched, started and checked; the old one is kept, unused
   3. start Kazma again and see it ready
  A part that fails is put back as it was; the others still move.
